records.title: Free-water WLS
records.method: Diagonal-free weight multiplication and source-qualified direct tensor-helper calls remove repeated allocation and compatibility checks.
records.baseline: Original installed DIPY WLS, not an earlier plugin. One numerical thread in both paths.
records.unchanged: All 13 raw fit parameters, four maps/masks, affines, dtypes and automatic QC match. The same 116935 voxels remain excluded.
records.limitation: One subject, one pair on a shared Linux host; optimized first. OS caches were not flushed. Both calls include raw-parameter evidence export.
records.sample: 740916 mask voxels; 288 measurements; automatic QC passes, anatomical review pending.
records.upstream_reference: Measured DIPY 1.12.1; latest stable at review: 1.12.1. Current stable-release full-brain pair.

records.title: WMA registration & classification
records.method: Bulk geometry copying and verified registration-input reuse reduce repeated Python/VTK traversal and preparation.
records.baseline: Original-author processing versus equivalent bulk/cache implementation, with identical UKF input and atlas.
records.unchanged: All 74 anatomical-tract output files are byte-identical; source inputs and author code are unchanged.
records.limitation: One full-module pair on a shared Linux host. Matching files do not certify small-bundle sampling or anatomical validity. Later transform optimizations are not measured by this pair.
records.sample: Full registration and 74-tract output; no streamline downsampling introduced for timing.
records.upstream_reference: Author commit 4532b911386d: matches current HEAD and measured source bytes.

records.title: NODDI / AMICO
records.method: Use AMICO's existing native multithreading: one thread versus eight.
records.baseline: The same author implementation and model settings. This is a thread-configuration comparison, not a new algorithm.
records.unchanged: NDI, ODI, IsoVF, RMSE, NRMSE and the tissue-validity mask match voxelwise, including affines.
records.limitation: One shared-host pair. Hardware-specific multithreading benefit; not a universal speed or whole-workflow guarantee.
records.sample: Original 740916-voxel brain mask; fresh output directories.
records.upstream_reference: AMICO 2.1.1 verified in both timed configurations; latest stable at review. Threads are already upstream functionality.

records.title: MK-Curve QR / Python port
records.method: Reuse protocol/design checks and LAPACK workspace sizes while keeping the same pivoted QR and full b0 grid.
records.baseline: Current SciPy 1.18.1 public gelsy solver versus qualified direct-driver/cache use in the same Python port. NOT original MATLAB versus Python.
records.unchanged: Raw coefficients, full curves, every map and validity decision match in all three subjects; both reference and batched solvers checked.
records.limitation: Table shows subject 100206 default-QR medians, three alternating repeats after warmup. Numeric chunks exclude input preparation and file export; not whole ROI or full brain. SciPy already supplies native batching.
records.sample: Three real 64-voxel chunks; 181 measurements; complete 200-201 point b0 grids; one numerical thread.
records.upstream_reference: Current MATLAB reference 9a213e1a5850; measured on current stable SciPy 1.18.1. This port-only comparison does not claim to outperform MATLAB or invent upstream native batching.

records.title: DKI WLS metrics
records.method: Evaluate the author's existing array-capable kurtosis metrics once per block, avoiding repeated per-voxel result wrappers.
records.baseline: Previous plugin per-voxel integration versus existing DIPY array usage. No improvement over the author's native vectorized API is claimed.
records.unchanged: All exported voxel arrays and affines match in three subjects, with three alternating repeats each.
records.limitation: Table shows subject 100307 medians. This adopts existing native DIPY functionality, not a new upstream algorithm improvement. No completed full-brain DKI pair; do not scale ROI times to whole brain.
records.sample: Three subjects; three repeats per path; native-grid ROI, no resampling; DIPY 1.12.1 with SciPy 1.18.1.
records.upstream_reference: DIPY 1.12.1 is current stable at review. Array metrics already exist upstream; this is plugin integration, not an author-algorithm speedup.

records.title: Independent FW + DKI jobs
records.method: Overlap independent model subprocesses after their shared inputs are ready; preserve downstream dependencies.
records.baseline: The same model computations, serial scheduling versus two concurrent workers.
records.unchanged: All exported scalar and mask arrays match. Process startup is included.
records.limitation: One ROI pair. This reduces schedule wall time, not the cost of an individual scientific model. Default model concurrency remains one; memory/CPU budgets may prevent overlap.
records.sample: Two independent models; CPU/memory-constrained scheduling; not full-brain timing.
records.upstream_reference: Historical plugin scheduler comparison, not a latest-upstream algorithm performance claim.

records.title: WMA atlas length filtering
records.method: Replace per-point Python geometry copying with equivalent bulk coordinate/topology operations.
records.baseline: Unmodified author filter on the full 1989106-streamline registration atlas.
records.unchanged: Output coordinates/topology and fixed-seed samples match exactly.
records.limitation: One full-atlas substage pair, not complete WMA. The large local ratio must not be multiplied by or added to the full WMA result.
records.upstream_reference: Same immutable current WMA source audit as the full-module record.

records.title: Free-water NLS dispatch
records.method: Call source-qualified author NLS, residual and Jacobian bodies directly, removing repeated keyword-compatibility dispatch.
records.baseline: Installed original DIPY 1.12.1 serial NLS versus the same function bodies; one numerical thread in both paths.
records.unchanged: All 13 raw parameters, exported maps, affine and QC decisions match in all three subjects.
records.limitation: Subject 100307 medians, three alternating repeats after warmup. ROI, not full brain. These timings precede later WLS-initialization/helper changes and cannot be added to them.
records.sample: Three native 12-cubed ROIs; 288 measurements; complete ROI stage including fresh export.
records.upstream_reference: Measured DIPY 1.12.1 in Slicer; author NLS/residual/Jacobian source hashes match the dated stable-source audit.

records.title: WMA point transformation
records.method: Use the same author vtkTransform with a bounded bulk point call, instead of one Python/VTK call per point.
records.baseline: Unmodified author point-transform loop versus bulk calls with the same float64 point order and transform.
records.unchanged: All transformed points, complete small-optimizer trajectories and final transforms match in three subjects.
records.limitation: Subject 100206 median of five point-transform repeats, not full registration. Small-optimizer gains were only about 1.27-1.28x; the point-kernel ratio cannot be applied to whole WMA.
records.sample: Three real-subject fixtures; explicit synthetic offset for the separate optimizer check.
records.upstream_reference: Author register_two_subjects.py SHA256 matches the 22 October WMA source audit; measured bulk vtkTransform path.

records.title: WMA fiber-array conversion
records.method: Gather the same author nearest-neighbor fiber samples from VTK connectivity in bounded NumPy blocks.
records.baseline: Unmodified author FiberArray conversion versus equivalent bulk conversion; no interpolation or streamline reduction added.
records.unchanged: All arrays, hemisphere flags and separate small-optimizer trajectories/transforms match in three subjects.
records.limitation: Subject 100206 median of five conversion repeats. Not whole WMA; small-optimizer gains were only about 1.02-1.05x. Historical source sampling failures remain failed.
records.sample: 20000 identical sampled fibers per subject; original nearest-neighbor rule and ordering.
records.upstream_reference: Author fibers.py at 4532b911386d independently verified; native VTK array sampling, not a new registration algorithm.

records.title: WMA registration-input reuse
records.method: Reuse verified deterministic atlas/subject length-filter results across seeds; keep fresh author random sampling.
records.baseline: Three original author preparation calls versus first cache fill plus reuse, with the same input and fixed seeds.
records.unchanged: Bitwise-equal registration input signatures; source hashes unchanged
records.limitation: One subject, one pair; includes initial cache construction. This overlaps WMA filtering and the full-module pair; savings cannot be added.
records.sample: Three fixed-seed preparation calls, including first cache fill; not full WMA
records.upstream_reference: Preserved same-author preparation pair. Source-qualified reuse, not a fresh latest-version benchmark.

records.title: DDSurfer surface-map reuse
records.method: Pack four overlays into one multi-frame mri_surf2surf call, sharing the same surface registration.
records.baseline: Four separate FreeSurfer commands versus one multi-frame command. Inherited from DDSurfer upstream c3b2d40, not plugin-original work.
records.unchanged: Four byte-identical MGH outputs; 163842 vertices per overlay; source hashes unchanged
records.limitation: One subject, command timing only; extra packing/validation excluded. Not surface reconstruction or a new FreeSurfer algorithm.
records.sample: 100307 left hemisphere; four separate FreeSurfer commands versus one multi-frame command
records.upstream_reference: Optimization inherited from DDSurfer c3b2d40; no plugin-original credit or latest-FreeSurfer speed claim.

records.title: Compressed DWI block reading
records.method: Decode gzip once to temporary disk, then memory-map the same requested blocks; leave the source file unchanged.
records.baseline: Repeated compressed-array reads versus one sequential decode and disk-backed block reads; no indexed_gzip in this measurement.
records.unchanged: Exact arrays and affine for all three slabs; unchanged input hash
records.limitation: One subject, one pair, uncontrolled OS page cache; needs temporary disk. I/O only, not model fitting; no universal storage-performance guarantee.
records.sample: Three real slabs including sequential decode. NOT a model-fit or full pipeline speedup.
records.upstream_reference: Generic compression/I/O control, not an improvement to a scientific estimator or an upstream-freshness claim.

upstream_review.policy: Latest release and default-branch source identity are checked separately; source review is not a development-branch benchmark.

policy: Output equivalence is not anatomical or clinical validation. No whole-workflow speedup has been established.
